admission_condition: The deterministic signed inclusion-exclusion construction never exceeds one fixed polynomial capability L^q

audit.claim_boundary: Only arrangements whose charged signed intersection support remains within one fixed polynomial capability. Exponential intersection closure, arbitrary 3-CNF, unrestricted Horn-affine composition, and P versus NP remain open.
audit.constructive_theorem: Affine-coordinate CNF is polynomially decidable whenever the deterministic signed inclusion-exclusion construction has polynomially bounded distinct nonempty intersection support. Exact union counting yields UNSAT covers; conditional counts recover a SAT witness.

claim_boundary: Fixed-polynomial signed intersection support only. Exponential closure, arbitrary 3-CNF, unrestricted Horn-affine composition, and P versus NP remain open.
constructive_theorem: Affine-coordinate CNF is decidable in polynomial total work when its charged signed affine-intersection support remains polynomially bounded. Exact signed counting gives UNSAT covers and conditional signed counts recover a SAT witness.
exact_object: Signed nonzero intersection support of clause-falsifying affine subspaces in GF(2)^d
